items.title: Notifications on your phone
items.text: Your computer's notices, such as an automation's result, reach the Toskar app even when it's closed or you're away from home. A notice about a web page opens it with a tap, and connecting a device offers to turn them on.

items.title: A better model, when it would help
items.text: After an answer, Toskar may offer a model that would have answered it better, for code, your files, or your language, and installs it in one tap. Turn the offers off in Settings.

items.title: Automations that see and react
items.text: Run an automation the moment a device changes, such as a doorbell's person sensor or a door contact in Home Assistant, and have it look at your cameras, so it can tell you who's at the door.

items.title: Muse Glimmer 30B for Research
items.text: Research recommends Muse Glimmer 30B on computers with room for it. It answered every reasoning question right in our tests, codes well, and reads pictures.

items.title: See pictures and clips come together
items.text: While a picture or clip is made, Toskar shows whether the model is loading, which step it's on with about how long is left, and a frame where the result will appear.

items.title: Honest fit on a Mac
items.text: How well a model fits now counts the memory a Mac's graphics may use, so a 24 GB Mac isn't told a 30B model runs comfortably, and a picture too big for this computer is turned down with the size that fits.
